title: Cruise ship outside of the mall? This is new for me
content: Has anyone else seen or experienced the huge cruise ship outside of the mall? I had such a vivid dream last night where I was in a more or less typical mall dream, but it was combined with elements that normally occur in my more “regular” dreams. It felt like a LONG dream, too. I spent what seemed like the majority of the dream frantically packing and repacking bags right there in the mall. I was told I needed to board by midnight, and I had 3 hours to go, but somehow I kept leaving all kinds of stuff scattered on the floor and was getting stressed because no matter how many times I shoved all the items back in their bags, somehow I was finding more that needed to be packed. I was with a couple other people I don’t recognize and they seemingly had their proverbial shit together. They kept reassuring me I had plenty of time or whatever but the whole process of boarding seemed impossibly difficult. I recall making some last minute rounds to a couple stores to grab last minute things. A lady at a perfume counter offered me a sample but then refused to give it to me so I walked off like screw this, I don’t have time. The ship was in a harbor outside. It was night, snow was falling, the sidewalks were slick and icy. I remember making my way to the ship from the dock a couple of times, but always backtracking for something I accidentally left behind. I woke up before boarding the ship but no surprise there. I often have similar dreams about the mall airport. It seems finally boarding in many cases ends the dream, so I’m not surprised. Most of the dream is the same though, just trying to pack and repack my bags while waiting to board. The ship is new- I’ve never been on a cruise irl, either. Has anyone else been here? What is the ship like?
